newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Inco to pay 5 cts interim 1996 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Inco to pay 5 cts interim 1996 dividend.

text.p: Indonesian nickel firm PT International Nickel Indonesia, majority-owned by Inco Ltd, announced on Friday it would pay a 1996 interim dividend of 5 U.S. cents per share.

The company said in a statement the dividend is payable on December 12 to shareholders on record as of November 13, 1996. It said the dividend would be paid in rupiah equivalent for Indonesian shareholders and in U.S. dollars to foreign shareholders.
"The final dividend for 1996 will be considered at the company's annual general meeting of shareholders on April 10, 1997," it said.
